question: 在固定BTC五分钟文件收盘代理中，RV减去归一化BV是否为正；这一有限样本差额是否仍只能保留为描述量？
mechanism: Rare discontinuities and continuous volatility contribute differently to squared-return sums and adjacent absolute-return products under explicit model assumptions. Single-asset risk-measurement question, not reversal, lead-lag or covariance.
novelty: Project-level new estimand and mechanism. Roll studies demeaned signed price-change covariance; this uses squared log returns versus adjacent absolute log returns. Async studies cross-asset alignment. Shared exposed data are reuse, not an independent new sample or scientific novelty.

input.exposure: Previously read by multiple project studies; development only. No new numeric price rows read in discovery.

minimal_experiment.gate: Research role freezes own protocol/code before reading numbers; verify exact hash, target identity, UTC conversion, unique minute timestamps and all 1440 positive finite close values. Fail on missing/duplicate/invalid minutes, no fill/interpolation. Schema and count expectations reuse the prior full audit; current discovery only rehashes bytes.
minimal_experiment.grid: One 5-minute grid anchored to dataset event_start, use close of final minute in each complete block. Expected 288 file-proxy endpoints and 287 adjacent log returns; expectations are not new measured counts. No window-external start price; report actual endpoint support and omit initial four minutes before first selected endpoint.
minimal_experiment.formula: r_j=ln(P_j/P_(j-1)); RV=sum(r_j^2); BV=(pi/2)*sum(abs(r_j)*abs(r_(j-1))) over adjacent returns; D=RV-BV. Use raw finite-sample BV without n/(n-1) correction. Preserve D<0, do not clip to a jump estimate.
minimal_experiment.baseline: RV is total squared-return proxy; BV is contrasting absolute-product statistic; descriptive D=0 reference only, not a finite-sample calibrated null test.
minimal_experiment.counterevidence: D<=0 within numerical precision rejects the narrow positive-excess description on this frozen proxy. D>0 supports only that description, not jump existence, probability or predictive value. A mismatch in input gate stops computation.
minimal_experiment.precision: Freeze float64 plus independent Decimal log implementation with >=40 decimal precision before scan; error tolerance 1e-12*max(RV,BV,1e-12); values within tolerance of zero are NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED. No parameter, grid-offset or date selection after results.

required_data: Existing exact exposed BTC candle bytes suffice only for file-proxy arithmetic
Latent jump attribution requires separately qualified price/quote observations, chronology, coverage and a noise/finite-sample inference method; none certified here
Any later trading claim needs a new prospective rule, untouched validation data and all required fee/slippage/funding/inventory/exit costs
completion_criteria: One frozen single-grid descriptive calculation with crosscheck, or a precise input/method failure; preserve all outputs and limitations. No jump significance, event count, strategy or economic FINAL.
resource_expectation: One local pass through the existing 44,243-byte ZIP and at most its previously audited 1440 minute rows, standard-library arithmetic, no download, no model API or broad parameter search. Wall time and token usage UNKNOWN until executed.
priority: Eligible small independent measurement proposal when research next selects work; does not supersede qualified formal-cost inputs or due reviews. No claim/route started by discovery.
defer_reason: Numerical experiment belongs to research role; causal jump attribution lacks qualified observations and inference.
restart_condition: Initial frozen diagnostic may be selected without user approval. After terminal result, do not repeat same day/grid; resume only for correction or independently qualified, predeclared new evidence. Existing async stop remains binding.
economic_scope: No signal, positions or trades; actual_net=null, complete costs not evaluated or waived.
